title: sdr daily scratchpad - Sana Mehta - 2026-03-12
content:
Date: 2026-03-12
Owner: Sana Mehta (SDR)
Goal for today: 18 dials, 8 LinkedIn touches, 3 qualified meetings. Focus: fintech mid-market + consolidation plays.

MORNING PRIORITY (before 11:00)
- Follow up w/ Paystream (Inbound demo lead) — emailed demo recap 3/9, no reply. Try call, leave short voicemail referencing ROI deck.
- Book intro w/ Ops lead at Meridian Bank (target: 30-min intro).
- Pull updated list for 'fraud detection' keyword for next cadences (ask Alex for clean export).

CALL LIST (order + quick notes)
1) Paystream Inc. — Priya Shah (Head of Integrations) — inbound demo lead — Stage: MQL -> SQL follow-up
   Notes: Demo 3/9, liked latency/cost comparison. Concern: in-house vendor lock.
   Script: "Quick question — did you get a chance to review the ROI deck? Any blockers on pilot budget?"
   Next action: Call at 10:15, if no answer send 1-line email + link to one-pager.

2) Meridian Bank — Carlos Vega (Director, Platform) — Outbound cold
   Notes: Mentioned interest in private deployment and KMS. Ask about compliance/regulatory timeline.
   Script: "We help banks reduce per-token cost while keeping KMS in your VPC — is that something you’re thinking about for 2026?"
   Next action: Call 11:00; if interested book 30-min demo with Solutions Eng.

3) TokenSafe (fintech aggregator) — Emma Lopez (VP Product) — Cadence step 3
   Notes: Interested in batching and KV cache optimizations. Wants cost estimate for 500 req/s.
   Next action: Capture metrics, flag to AE to produce rough TCO. 

4) DataHarbor — Raj Patel (SRE) — Follow-up on scale test docs
   Notes: Ran a load test, reported memory blowups on 2.2.1 runtime. Open ticket GT-1287.
   Next action: Ping infra, request ETA on patch; tell customer ETA and temporary mitigation.

5) BrightForms — Olivia Chen (Head of Integrations) — Reconnect
   Notes: Talked 2/20, asked for customer references in fintech.
   Next action: Send intro to reference customers + schedule 20-min chat.

HOT EMAILS TO SEND (templates)
- Quick ROI nudge (to Paystream):
  Subject: Quick follow up on ROI deck
  Hi Priya,

  Wanted to check if you had any questions on the ROI deck I shared — happy to jump on a 10-min call to walk through the numbers and pilot options.

  Best,
  Sana

- Compliance play (to Meridian):
  Subject: Private deployment + KMS options for Meridian
  Hi Carlos,

  Quick note — we have a short checklist for banks evaluating private deployments and KMS integrations. If you want, I can send it over or walk through with your security lead.

  Cheers,
  Sana

LINKEDIN MESSAGES (short)
- "Hi Carlos — saw Meridian's note on platform scaling. We help banks run LLMs in VPCs with KMS/HSM integration. Quick intro call?"

PIPELINE NOTES / BLOCKERS
- Paystream: AE (Alex M) needs to finalize pricing tier for pilot. Waiting on Alex for committed numbers.
- DataHarbor: infra bug GT-1287 blocking demo. Escalated to engineering; ask SRE for temporary config.
- TokenSafe: needs sample throughput numbers; escalate to Solutions Eng (Maya) for ballpark estimate by EOD.

TODAY'S TASKS (checklist)
[ ] 18 dials (target)
[ ] 8 LinkedIn touches
[ ] Email ROI nudge to Paystream
[ ] Send compliance checklist to Meridian
[ ] Pull fraud-keyword export (ask Alex)
[ ] Update GT-1287 ticket with customer repro steps

NOTES TO SELF / TL;DRS
- Keep pitches short (30s value prop): "Reduce inference cost 3x while preserving latency SLOs; private or hosted depending on compliance."
- If they push security, lead with Private + KMS + audit logs.
- For cost objections, show sample TCO (tokens/month x model) rather than per-hour GPU talk.

FOLLOW-UPS (timing)
- If no reply to ROI nudge by 3/14 -> escalate to AE for intro.
- If Meridian asks for compliance checklist, schedule call same week (target: 3/16).

END-OF-DAY REFLECTION (to fill out later)
- Wins: quick notes on meetings booked, objections, playbook updates needed.
- Questions for Alex/Maya: export readiness, pricing tiers, demo env for Paystream.

Misc quick references:
- Pitch doc link (Confluence): playbooks/outreach-templates
- Open ticket: JIRA GT-1287 (DataHarbor memory issue)
- CRM record: SFDC-0003456 (Paystream Inc.)
